# PowerShell completion for jet (generated by `jet self completions powershell`)
$JetCommands = @('registry','db','inspect','bind','project','self','diff','merge','review','run','jobs','generate','check','fill','test','test-compare','prove','status','build','package','flash','cc','c++','dev','learn','try','debug','repl','notebook','import','new','fmt','fix','audit','lint','doc','explain','env','shared-store','cache','remote','trust','image','os','add','remove','fetch','search','find','update','init','split','Fold','gc','clean','emit','eval','budget','perf','fuzz','version','help')
$JetFlags = $JetGroups = @{ 'registry' = @('publish','yank','keygen','key','vendor'); 'db' = @('migrate'); 'inspect' = @('types','rights','claims','shapes','accel','decisions','structure','build','gates','graph','query','explain-build','compiler','impact','provenance','digest','env','semindex','output','expand','schema','codemod','audit','sbom','bind','logs','info','outdated','reserved'); 'project' = @('parts'); 'self' = @('toolchain','update','doctor','completions','man','devtools','lsp','exec'); 'env' = @('test','hook','sync','info'); 'shared-store' = @('install','enroll','status','broker'); 'cache' = @('status','prune','limit'); 'os' = @('push','bridge','services','config'); 'gc' = @('report'); 'perf' = @('run','test','attach','view','compare','export') }
$JetJobs = @((& jet --json jobs 2>$null | ConvertFrom-Json).jobs.name)
Register-ArgumentCompleter -Native -CommandName jet -ScriptBlock {
param($wordToComplete,$commandAst,$cursorPosition)
$words = @($commandAst.CommandElements | ForEach-Object { $_.Extent.Text })
$choices = if ($wordToComplete.StartsWith('-')) {
$JetFlags
} elseif ($words.Count -ge 2 -and $words[1] -eq 'jobs') {
$JetJobs
} elseif ($words.Count -ge 2 -and $JetGroups.ContainsKey($words[1])) {
$JetGroups[$words[1]]
} else {
$JetCommands
}
$choices | Where-Object { $_ -like "$wordToComplete*" } |
ForEach-Object { [System.Management.Automation.CompletionResult]::new($_,$_,"ParameterValue",$_) }
}
